{"reason":"Change only the medium/high fallback action to alert-planner. At 35,000 versus 45,000, always on time, it makes all 34 switches cheaper and fixes the shown 2.8/5.3-day stockouts. Retaining the existing expedite yields projected cost 1,225,000 versus 2,165,000 and stockouts 0 versus 4; low risk still monitors.","source":"(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'high))
         (< inventory-days 5))
      (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
      (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    (else
      (list 'monitor))))"}
